title: Water in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of H₂O and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Oxygen has two bonding regions and two lone pairs. The atoms form a bent structure, not a straight line.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Oxygen has two bonding regions and two lone pairs. The atoms form a bent structure, not a straight line.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: Oxygen has two bonding regions and two lone pairs. The atoms form a bent structure, not a straight line.
The stage is a schematic model and is not drawn to scale.

recall.question: What is the molecular shape of H₂O around its central atom?
recall.why: Oxygen has two bonding regions and two lone pairs. The atoms form a bent structure, not a straight line.
